title: The Asteroid That 'Missed' Earth—Then Caused a 10-Year Winter Anyway
hook: It didn't hit us—but its dust cloud circled the planet and blocked the sun for a decade.

title: The Dark Matter 'Ocean' That We're Swimming Through Right Now

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an invisible ocean surrounding us feels eerie and personal, linking daily life to cosmic mystery.

why_this_can_go_viral: Existential dread mixed with a direct warning creates high emotional engagement and debate.

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an invisible galaxy passing through us is eerie and challenges our perception of reality.

why_this_can_go_viral: The timing of the signal stopping feels like an intelligent response—immediately viral.
